## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat(scope): ...`, `fix: ...`, `docs: ...`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `nox` passes locally
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]` (or the PR is labelled `skip-changelog`)
- [ ] Public API, docstrings and README updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] No credentials, tokens or private data in code, tests or logs
